02-PRD / Amazon FBA Product Scouting

Goes here. Baseline frameworks and active sourcing tactics for identifying profitable Amazon FBA products using software intelligence tools (Helium 10 Black Box). Focuses on establishing strict margin floors, evaluating keyword variability, analyzing price disparity, and identifying low-hanging competitor vulnerabilities.

Not here. • Calculating landed costs, tariffs, and FBA fees or sourcing from manufacturers -> [06-OPS] / Supply Chain & Sourcing • Running and optimizing Amazon PPC advertising campaigns -> [04-MED] / Paid Media Execution • Designing product packaging or Amazon listing images -> [03-CRE] / Performance Ad Creative

Topics. • The Anti-Portfolio (What to Avoid)
Discarding cheap (<$10) products that invite heavy competition and have profit margins instantly destroyed by PPC costs.
Avoiding seasonal, trendy, gated, or patented items to prevent dead inventory and storage fees. • The Viability Criteria (What to Target)
Premium pricing models to absorb marketing costs.
Avoiding categories dominated by massive legacy brands (brand monopolies). • Keyword Variability & Price Disparity
Prioritizing products with dozens of distinct search descriptions to unlock long-tail organic ranking.
Analyzing Page 1 pricing spreads to avoid a "race to the bottom." • Helium 10 Black Box Mechanics
Using strict numerical filters to isolate high-revenue, low-sophistication competitors in ungated categories. • Review Mining for Product Gaps
Using sub-optimal review ratings as a blueprint for manufacturing improvements.

Look for. • Margin floor: Require >30% net profit margin after all landed costs and FBA fees are calculated. Set a minimum retail price of $25+ to safely absorb Amazon PPC clicks. • Keyword variability: Target products that can be described by dozens of long-tail keywords (e.g., "slim phone case", "waterproof phone case") rather than a single monolithic term. • Price disparity check: Search the product on Amazon. Ensure Page 1 has a wide pricing spread (e.g., items selling for $20, $50, and $100). If all Page 1 results are tightly clustered (e.g., $7 to $13), discard the product. • Helium 10 filter mechanics: Set Categories to ungated (e.g., Home, Patio, Pet, Office). Set Review Count Max = 300. Set Price = $25 to $60. Set Monthly Revenue = $5,000 to $20,000 (limits the capital required for inventory). Set Listing Age Minimum = 8 months (validates evergreen status). Set Image Count Max = 4 (identifies unsophisticated sellers). • Review mining mechanics: Sort Helium 10 results by review rating (lowest to highest). Locate products with 4.1 to 4.3 stars generating >$5k/month. Read the 1-star reviews to extract the exact physical improvements needed before contacting a supplier.
Skip. Do not capture pitches for the creator's consultation calls, free trainings, or Helium 10 affiliate links. Ignore dashboard income claims ($100k/mo).
Scope mix. 60% baseline (Amazon fundamentals and viability formulas), 40% growth (Helium 10 specific execution tactics).
Volume. ~250 words.
